# The heavy build (addendum 2.3 section 11): broad shoulders, a thick torso and limbs, big hands,
# for residents and enemies, never the steerer; an ordinary working person, neither labelled nor
# gendered. The same 32 x 48 cell (about 4 px wider), frame counts, facings and timing as the
# steerer, moving heavier. Proposed, staged for the user's approval; nothing here is read by the
# game. Generated by assets/art/authoring/people48.py; edit that script, not this map.
# Clothing layer: shares the body sheet's states, frames, facings and anchor.
sheet: layer_clothing_tunic_heavy
kind: sprite
palette: book07
size: 32x48
pivot: 16,47
footprint: 10x4
facings: s n e w
placeholder: false
anim.idle: frames 4, ticks 15, loop
anim.shift: frames 4, ticks 20, loop
anim.glance: frames 4, ticks 24, loop
anim.idlewind: frames 4, ticks 9, loop
anim.walk: frames 6, ticks 5, loop
anim.run: frames 8, ticks 3, loop
anim.runstart: frames 1, ticks 4
anim.runstop: frames 2, ticks 6
anim.sneak: frames 6, ticks 6, loop
anim.carry: frames 6, ticks 5, loop
anim.draw: frames 4, ticks 8
event.footstep: walk 0, walk 3, run 0, run 4, sneak 0, sneak 3, carry 0, carry 3
# The outline and the three tones are authored in the map (people48.py), aware of the
# layers below this one, so the generator adds no outline of its own.
outline: . 4
mark.A: stone_warm 3
mark.B: stone_warm 1
mark.C: stone_warm 2
mark.D: stone_warm 0
mark.E: tar 2
mark.F: tar 0
mark.G: stone 6
mark.H: earth 1
mark.I: earth 3
mark.J: earth 2
mark.L: wool 4
mark.M: wool 3
mark.N: wool 1
mark.O: wool 2
mark.P: tar 3
mark.Q: tar 1
mark.R: stone 8
mark.S: earth 0
mark.T: wool 0
mark.U: stone 5
mark.k: ink 0
